cases.obligation: The maintained autostart plugin is configured with exactly the Engine process-mode argument.
Repeated autostart setup overwrites one named logical registration with the same exact command and preserves cardinality one.
A failed autostart enable operation is returned as a registration failure.
An autostart registration whose stored command does not exactly match the requested command is returned as a failure.
An error while verifying autostart registration is returned as a verification failure.
The production Windows autostart serializer quotes a spaced executable path and appends exactly the Engine mode argument.
Actual Windows Engine and Settings processes remain alive concurrently under one executable identity.
A concurrently running Settings process adds no content window or WebView2 descendant to the Engine process.
A second actual Settings launch exits successfully and reactivates the existing minimized Settings window while Engine remains alive.
The production Settings CloseRequested leaf requests process exit.
The explicit process-test exit seam removes the Settings process and WebView2 descendants after Engine connection while Engine remains running.
Two concurrent cold Settings launches converge on exactly one live Settings process and one content window while Engine remains alive.
Repeated tray open requests spawn the current executable with exactly the Settings process-mode argument.
The Engine Quit leaf requests worker shutdown before process exit.
The production Engine Quit seam has shutdown and exit capabilities only, so it cannot mutate login autostart registration.
